galacta-star-commandos.specific_finding: The summary gives each player movement, shooting, close-combat and morale phases and does not restrict moved figures from shooting. The original1980HeritageHowToPlay front explicitly defines four phases for the entire turn: A moves, A shoots, B moves, B shoots. Only figures that did not move in their movement phase may shoot; close combat is allowed even after movement and saving throws are made within that attack step. Replacing this with four phases per player and allowing the implied move-then-fire sequence changes core activation and attack eligibility. Specific MAJOR for this completely visible base-turn procedure only. Reverse-side combat exceptions, full roster/scenarios and optional rules remain missing; no full summary audit or body repair.
